item.title: Superior Boys Hockey Moves On to D1 Regional Title Game After Taking Down Merrill
item.description: SUPERIOR, Wis.- The Superior boys hockey team extended their season on Tuesday night, defeating Merrill Co-Op 6 to 2 in the Division 1 regional semifinal.
